name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring at 80% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff offset. This balances visibility for keyboard users against visual noise, ensuring the ring doesn’t clash with busy backgrounds or reduced-motion contexts. The 4.5:1 contrast ratio meets WCAG 2.1 AA for interactive elements, while the inner white offset prevents color blending with adjacent elements. Trade-off: the 80% opacity may reduce prominence for users with low vision, but the inner offset compensates by sharpening the ring’s edges.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring at 80% opacity fails WCAG 2.1 AA on dark backgrounds—contrast drops below 4.5:1. A 1px solid #005fcc ring at 100% opacity meets 4.5:1 on both light and dark themes without visual noise. Test both on a dark theme with a busy background to settle it.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 1px solid #005fcc focus ring at 100% opacity with a 1px inner offset. This meets 4.5:1 contrast on both light and dark backgrounds without failing on busy themes. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than a thicker ring, but it avoids the contrast collapse that 80% opacity causes on dark surfaces.

name: Reader
text: The 1px ring risks disappearing on touch devices where fingers obscure small targets. A 2px ring at 90% opacity keeps prominence while still hitting 4.5:1 on dark themes—test it on a Samsung Galaxy A51 at 100% zoom to settle.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring at 90% opacity with a 1px inner #ffffff offset. Deliver a tested, WCAG 2.1 AA-compliant focus ring style across light/dark themes and touch devices; owner: Ramp.
